No financing, no loan, just wrote a check. You smile, nod, refill your drink, but on the drive home you can't stop thinking about it because two streets over lives a

Drop a comment telling me how many of these 13 signs match somebody in your life. I read every single one. And if there's a sign you think I missed, tell me that, too. I'm always taking notes for the next one. I'll see you in the next one.
script.analysis: Complete13-sign list read. Repeated sign-number resets and direct prompts create text-level momentum,not measured retention. Named researchers,precise percentages and biographies lend authority;two strong reversals bookend car/house examples. Major factual risk is reverse inference from appearance and selected samples. DALBAR2023gap contradicts transcript;bankruptcy identity remains unverified/suspected conflation. ExactStanley tables,IRS4xsource and detailedFeeney/Readclaims unresolved. No actual neighbors or financial outcomes authenticated.

topic.analysis: Recognition of concealed wealth versus conspicuous consumption. Mechanisms are spending below income,avoiding expensive debt,retaining/investing cashflow and time compounding. Surveys and biographies support only bounded examples. The script repeatedly turns selected-millionaire attributes into certainty about unobserved neighbors;income,liquidity,net worth and investable assets must stay distinct.
topic.audience_problem: Viewers compare themselves with affluent-looking neighbors and want financial identity reassurance and practical saving habits.
topic.narrative_angle: Thirteen numbered reversals with barbecue opening,prestige ridicule,biographical contrast and final neighborhood guessing exercise.
topic.novelty_and_corpus_angle: Test a balance-sheet-based alternative:separate appearance from assets/debts,demonstrate conditional-probability/base-rate failure,and qualify survey dates. Compare comprehension and voluntary first-party analytics against recognition-list packaging.
topic.competition: Same-channel nearest-age peers inK01;not independent niche or causal test
